sentences.en: I raised the binoculars again and looked at the cemetery.
sentences.zh: 我又举起了双筒望远镜，看向墓地。

sentences.en: Lend me the binoculars so I can see it better.
sentences.zh: 借我用一下双筒望远镜，这样我能看得更清楚。

sentences.en: Do you have a pair of binoculars I could borrow?
sentences.zh: 我可以借用一下你的双筒望远镜吗？

senses.zh: [光] 双筒望远镜；[光] 双筒镜，[光] 双目镜
